label: Is every holder of the joint-absence power the selected root that the intellect routes reach?
summary: See docs/notes/holder-root-identification.md. Verified zero-axiom results: 88f1ee6e (every holder is an actual root of the selected grounding G on the frame's existence, from excluded middle, P2' 906f5c39, P3' a6906cab, holders existing at w and NAR, NECESSARY_2 actual concreta are roots), 1be2993c (813a9181 from that and the common GOD_4 root with intellect 0c27f65a), cb42e5e2 (every holder is GOD_4, the converse of 0050b6ed), 9b7683e1 (at most one holder from at most one actual root 49fdec01, whose uniqueness premise is a576300f, De ente's no-multiplication inventory), 834ddcfa (66aecdd7 from #1941's willed holder fdd2b1cf, 0050b6ed, at most one holder and 65e0179f). Law 1 derives the necessity of every holder from P2' and P3'. Main finding: uniqueness does not identify the holder; in the necessary-through-another model both uniqueness premises hold and the holder is a necessary being grounded by the root. The identification's crux is NAR. Frames joined only by FirstMoverNecessity.groundProfile; G is a parameter, not giving, causing, dependence or priority. Argument 5 shares the intellect route 571e36f0's dependencies and adds no independent warrant for 66aecdd7. Computed delta: six support alternatives added, four bare premises reach the root (NAR, holders at w, and 71fc097b, 9856239a through argument B).
blocker: Not blocked for the formal question. Open warrant: NAR (that a modally necessary actual concretum has no actual concrete ground). Its non-question-begging support is the aseity of modal necessity; free creation supports it only inside classical theism. Strongest rival: a necessary being necessarily emanated from the root that holds the two-way power (Avicennian necessary through another, as a hybrid with two-way giving below). Next test: whether #555's simplicity collapse extends to a source whose giving is fixed toward one necessary effect and two-way toward others (#1897 gap 6).
